visualCharacteristics: Section heading over a two-column grid of linked image cards; each card has an image, a linked heading, a description and a footer line, with an arrow overlay.
contentPattern: Row 1 (optional, no image): section heading. Every other row: one card (image, linked heading, description, footer line).
reuseGuidance: Reuse for grids of image cards that each link to a detail page.
